Here is a consolidated report based on reading the TSCN files and `combat_test_v1.gd`, `combat_test_v2.gd`, `combat_test.gd`, and `README_COMBAT_TEST_VERSIONS.md`.

## 1) Likely primary scene file path(s)

- **Full HUD you described (top-left/right boxed panels + three glyphs + mirrored play row + EXECUTE)** is implemented on  
  **`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test.tscn`**  
  Root node name is **`CombatTest2`**; script is **`res://combat/scripts/combat_test.gd`** (thin wrapper extending `combat_test_v1.gd`). README marks this as the default F6 entry.

- **`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/combat_test_v2.tscn`** is a **different layout** (“surreal chip-bar”), same instanced **`combat_root.tscn`**, script **`combat_test_v2.gd`**.

- **`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scenes/combat_root.tscn`** holds **grid-centric** overlays (multiplier/winnings labels in **viewport 2D offset space**, not the Control shell rectangles).

---

## 2) Exact node paths and relevant properties (from scenes + documented runtime parenting)

### `combat_test.tscn` (static tree; anchors/sizes below are overwritten for some nodes by scripts)

| Element | Approx node path (`CombatTest2/...`) | Notable props |
|--------|---------------------------------------|---------------|
| Full-screen backdrop | `BlackBackground` (ColorRect) | `anchors_preset` 15, full rect, black |
| Core combat | `CombatRoot` (instance) | **`visible = false` in TSCN**; `combat_test_v1.gd` turns it **`visible = true`** and reparents under `PlayArea/.../GridHost` |
| **Top-left rectangle** | `%MetaBox` → `TopBar/MetaBox` (PanelContainer) | `theme_override_styles/panel` = `StyleBoxFlat_corner_box` (dark bg, red border, ~4 px radius); TSCN offsets `24–264 × 12–88` |
| **Three icon “symbols”** | `TopBar/MetaBox/MetaContent/MetaIconsRow/` → `GearIcon`, `HomeIcon`, `ThirdIcon` (Labels) | Text `⚙`, `⌂`, `·`; HBox separation **8**, `alignment = 1`; children `size_flags_horizontal = 3` |
| Seed row | `.../SeedRow`, `%SeedSpinBox` | Numeric seed |
| **Top-right rectangle** | `%GoalBox` → `TopBar/GoalBox` (PanelContainer) | Same `StyleBoxFlat_corner_box`; TSCN anchored right (`anchor_left/right = 1`), offsets **`−264 … −24` × `12 … 88`** |
| Goal text | `%GoalLabel` in `GoalBox` | `text` starts `"GOAL\n0 / 0"` |
| Center bankroll / stake strip (separate from corners) | `TopBar/BankrollLabel`, `StakeSelector/BetRow/...` | Bankroll centered in bar; TSCN stake row `offset_top ≈ 120` |
| **`%MultiplierReadout`** | Initially child of **`CombatTest2`** | Default `text = "1X"`; **`layout_mode = 0`**, `offset_left = -1000`** (dummy off-screen until script places it)** |
| **Bottom “spin log” label (scene)** | `%BudgetLabel` | Anchors preset **12** (bottom stretch); `offset` left `12 … 280`, top **`−34 … −8`**; `theme_override_font_sizes/font_size = 20`; **`text = "SPIN LOG  0"`** |
| **Spin / execute** | `%SpinButton` | Anchored bottom-center (preset **7**); **`font_size = 60`**; **`text = "EXECUTE"`** in TSCN |
| Overlay | `ScanlineOverlay` (ColorRect + shader material) | Full rect |

**Runtime (after `combat_test_v1.gd`):**

- **`$TopBar` → `visible = false`**. **`%MetaBox`** and **`%GoalBox`** are **reparented to root** and sized with **fractional anchors** (not the TSCN TopBar offsets):
  - **Meta**: `anchor_left/right` **0.02–0.22**, **`top/bottom`** **0.01–0.12** (`LAYOUT_*` constants).
  - **Goal box**: **`0.78–0.98`** × **0.01–0.12**.
- **`%SpinButton`** and **`%MultiplierReadout`** are moved under **`CombatTest2/PlayArea/PlayRow/CenterColumn/CenterFooter`** (`_center_footer`).
- **`PremiumProgressBar`**: **`ProgressBar` created in code**, parent **`GridHost`**, `max_value = 3`, default height **`PREMIUM_BAR_HEIGHT` (= 10)**; position/size synced in **`_layout_premium_bar()`** to sit **directly under** `combat.grid_ui`.

### `combat_test_v2.tscn` (different HUD)

| Element | Path / origin | Notes |
|--------|----------------|-------|
| Seed | `%SeedSpinBox` under `TopLeftSeed` | No MetaBox / no three glyph row |
| Goal | `%GoalLabel` | Top-centered banner text (`GOAL: WIN …`) |
| Multiplier strip | `%MultiplierReadout` | Anchored **bottom-center** in TSCN, `font_size = 32`, initial **`×0`**; script updates to **`×%.1f`** from **spin win ratio** |
| Spin | `%SpinButton` | Smaller (**`−40 … 40` × −140 … −68**), **`font_size = 22`**, **`text = "SPIN"`** (also **NEXT** when scripted) |
| Progress bar | **Code**: `PremiumProgressBar` child of **`GridHost`**, **`size.y = 8`** in **`_layout_combat()`**, `max_value = 3` |
| “History”-like | **`MATCHED`** side panel (`_make_side_panel`): scroll **`ScrollContainer`** + **`VBoxContainer`** list of **`MatchedLogTile`** instances — not the v1 **`SPINS`** placeholder column |

### `combat_root.tscn`

- **`MultiplierLabel`** (Control under Node2D): `offset_left/top/right/bottom` **8 … 400 × 8 … 40**, **`font_size = 18`**, `text = "Multiplier: 1×"`.
- **`RoundWinningsLabel`** / **`WinningsOverlayLabel`**: **`ROUND WINNINGS  0.00`** styling; overlays use **`terminal_theme.tres`** on some labels.

Theme: **`res://combat/ui/terminal_theme.tres`** on Control roots where referenced.

---

## 3) Scripts that drive layout at runtime

- **`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test.gd`** — extends **`combat_test_v1.gd`** only.
- **`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test_v1.gd`** — **`_organize_top_hud`**, **`_build_play_shell`**, **`_apply_responsive_layout`**, **`_place_control_rect`**, **`_layout_combat`** / **`_layout_premium_bar`**, **`_build_spin_history_placeholder`**, reparent **`SpinButton`** / **`MultiplierReadout`**.
- **`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_test_v2.gd`** — **`_build_combat_frame`**, **`_layout_combat`**, responsive **`_apply_responsive_layout`**, **`_make_side_panel`** for MATCHED/ITEMS, reparent **`SpinButton`** / **`MultiplierReadout`** into **`_meta_vbox`**.
- **`C:/Users/valtt/OneDrive/Godot/AXEL/axel_project/combat/scripts/combat_root.gd`** — gameplay + chip-bar math APIs used by shells; **`grid_manager.gd`** drives grid.

---

## 4) Key ambiguities / variant differences

1. **`combat_test.tscn` vs `combat_test_v1.tscn`:** README says they share the **same** tree and behavior except script path; **`combat_test_v1.tscn` actually has no `TopBar`/ `%MetaBox` / `%GoalBox` / mirrored `StakeSelector` layout**. The v1 script still uses **`@onready … = %MetaBox`** — that is **inconsistent** with the standalone v1 TSCN unless those nodes exist elsewhere.

2. **“Three symbols” row**: Only present on **`combat_test.tscn`** (`MetaIconsRow`). **v2** does not duplicate it.

3. **“Bottom-left spin history”**: TSCN **`%BudgetLabel` (“SPIN LOG”)** exists on **`combat_test.tscn`/v1 copy**, but **`combat_test_v1.gd` sets `budget_label.visible = false`**, so **that label is hidden** during play; the visible “history-ish” strip is **`_spin_history_panel`** (vertical **“SPINS”** placeholder rows), **not** a literal scroll of past spin text tied to **`BudgetLabel`**.

4. **“Total winnings / 1×”**: **v1 multiplier readout** is **`MultiplierReadout`** = integer **`NcX`** from **`combat.get_multiplier_value()`**; **`combat_root`** has **`MultiplierLabel`** (“Multiplier: 1×”); **v2 **`MultiplierReadout`** shows **`×`** _spin payout ratio**, not necessarily the same as v1 **`NcX`** logic.

5. **Execute vs Spin**: **`combat_test.tscn`** defaults to **EXECUTE**; v1 toggles **EXECUTE** / **SPIN LOCKED**; **v2** uses **SPIN** / **NEXT** with a different Control footprint and pill radii (**40 px** corners on spin styles vs **8 px** in v1 default spin styles).

**Executive summary:** The UI kit matching **paired top-corner panels, three top-left glyphs, bottom premium bar next to grid, multiplier readout, and EXECUTE flow** centers on **`combat_test.tscn` + `combat_test_v1.gd`** (heavy **runtime reparent and anchor fractions**); **`combat_test_v2`** replaces that with chip bar + **MATCHED** log and different bottom multiplier/button semantics; **`combat_root.tscn`** adds separate grid-local multiplier/winnings labels.
